# GEO Readiness test site

> A fixture site used to exercise the geo-readiness module. It exists only to give
> the crawler check something predictable to read, with a known structure.

## Core pages

- [Home](http://localhost:9090/en/home.html): the landing page
- [Products](http://localhost:9090/en/products.html): what the fixture pretends to sell
- [Contact](http://localhost:9090/en/contact.html): a form that goes nowhere

## Documentation

- [Getting started](http://localhost:9090/docs/public/start.html): allowed for every crawler
- [API reference](http://localhost:9090/docs/public/api.html): also allowed
- [Internal notes](http://localhost:9090/docs/internal.html): disallowed for PerplexityBot

## Optional

- [Changelog](http://localhost:9090/en/changelog.html): release history
